g.text: 5 x 5 squares · DICT_4X4_50 · square 18 mm · marker 13.5 mm · outer size 90 x 90 mm
PRINT AT 100 % — “Actual size”, no “fit to page”, no scaling. Then measure the ruler below with a caliper.
← this line must measure exactly 100 mm
1. Glue it to a flat plate and clamp the plate to the gripper, board square to the approach direction.
2. Keep it rigid — do not re-tape it between poses; that is what the calibration measures.
3. Matte paper, no gloss: reflections are the main cause of failed detections.
